import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders

msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = "agent@localhost"
msg["To"] = "bob@example.com"
msg["Subject"] = "Customer Activity Report - Maya Chen"

body = """Hi Bob,

Please find attached the Customer Activity Report for Maya Chen.

The report includes order ORD-6C71B1 from 2026-09-02 with a total of $79.00.

Best regards,
Automated Report System"""

msg.attach(MIMEText(body, "plain"))

with open("docs/customer_report.pdf", "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=customer_report.pdf")
    msg.attach(part)

try:
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as server:
        server.sendmail("agent@localhost", "bob@example.com", msg.as_string())
    print("Email sent successfully to bob@example.com")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"SMTP localhost failed: {e}")
    try:
        with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 1025) as server:
            server.sendmail("agent@localhost", "bob@example.com", msg.as_string())
        print("Email sent successfully to bob@example.com (port 1025)")
    except Exception as e2:
        print(f"SMTP localhost:1025 also failed: {e2}")
        print("Saving email as .eml file instead")
        with open("docs/customer_report_email.eml", "w") as ef:
            ef.write(msg.as_string())
        print("Email saved as docs/customer_report_email.eml")
'''

pdf_script = '''import pymupdf
from docx import Document

# Read the DOCX content
doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Extract all text content
lines = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if text:
        lines.append(text)

# Also extract table content
for table in doc.tables:
    for row in table.rows:
        row_text = " | ".join(cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells)
        if row_text.strip("| "):
            lines.append(row_text)

# Create PDF using PyMuPDF
pdf_doc = pymupdf.open()
page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=595, height=842)  # A4 size

# Write content to PDF
y_pos = 50
fontsize_title = 16
fontsize_heading = 13
fontsize_normal = 10
line_height = 14

for line in lines:
    # Determine style
    if line == "Customer Activity Report":
        fs = fontsize_title
        font = "helv"
    elif line in ("Maya Chen", "Jordan Alvarez", "Evan Parker", "Nina Patel", "Alicia Morgan", "Sofia Ramirez"):
        fs = fontsize_heading
        font = "helv"
    else:
        fs = fontsize_normal
        font = "helv"

    # Check if we need a new page
    if y_pos > 790:
        page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=595, height=842)
        y_pos = 50

    # Insert text
    page.insert_text((50, y_pos), line, fontsize=fs, fontname=font)
    y_pos += fs + 4

pdf_doc.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf_doc.close()
print("PDF created successfully")
'''
